messages.text: There’s a new comment on PR# 90, address it
I’ll read the new comment on PR #90 and address it on the current branch.

The comment proposes staggered outer-barrel chambers that overlap in azimuth, plus longer chambers along \(z\) to reduce the count. I’ve inspected the sketch. I’ll test that layout with the coils and frame fixed, then check the full chamber volumes and crossings.

I’m using the repository’s design-evidence and independent-review workflows for this geometry change.

The Spack preflight again flags changed setup and lockfile fingerprints. I’ll verify the native runtime before using it. The magnetic sources and endcap chambers can remain fixed for this barrel revision.

The geometry supports the sketch’s approach: moving alternating outer facets outward by 0.55 m allows angular overlap while leaving about 69.6 mm of physical separation between neighbouring chamber volumes.

The wider chambers need cuts around the frame near the ends. I’m checking how much of the coverage gain survives those cuts, and whether longer sections can be joined safely without creating coil or frame conflicts.
